review.imagery: 42 gallery entries include 16 dated site photographs. All sixteen primary assets, the complete 40-page brochure index, forty native resources and sixteen dated September 2026 photographs were visually reviewed. One exact primary roof repeat, repeated brochure scenes, textures and generic lifestyle imagery were excluded. Eleven brochure scenes add building, roof, project-branded lobby, kitchen and wardrobe detail. Ten primary interiors are byte-identical to images independently published for Sunset Bay 2/4. Shared home and amenity concepts retain explicit scope. Project-specific historical photographs include the branded Sunset Bay One entrance.
review.floorPlans: All seven whole physical plan pages 2–8 were visually reviewed on two contacts. Ground/podium 1 retain paired 3 BR duplex portions. The even-floor group includes level 8. No individual saleable area is printed or inferred. The broker’s sole home drawing is behind its contact form and unretrieved. Original margins, level labels and physical source links remain intact. Seven complete building drawings retain the paired ground/podium duplex portions, grouped residential floors and rooftop amenities. No numerical individual saleable areas are printed. A separate broker home preview is form-gated and unretrieved. Confirm standalone contractual home sheets, complete duplex areas and final revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: Whole original brochure map 9 was rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. All twelve estimates follow its printed schedule. The unnamed metro, historical beach label and proposed island context remain qualified. No explicit target coordinates occur in the official named-place embed. Camera-centre values were excluded.
review.provenance: Official project/gallery and September 2026 construction sources retain dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Original brochures, factsheets and plan packets retain their actual broker/design-host attribution. Full sheets, notices and original source bytes remain intact. Protected researched records remain preserved.
